engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Voltage supply issue to Hydraulic Pump Motor (J156)
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) for Hydraulic Pump Motor (J156)
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Repair Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connector(s)
technicalNotes:
If no wiring issues are found from the Hydraulic Pump Motor (J156) to the ABS Kontrol Modülü (J104), then Değiştirin / Yenileyin: the Hydraulic Pump Motor (J156).
It is noted that replacing the ABS Kontrol Modülü (J104) should only be done as a "last resort".
